race.comment: INTRECCIATO (7) ran into a bit of trouble two back at Ipswich but saw clear air to launch hard at Beaudesert last time when getting within a length of the winner. At her top now and will take some stopping if the pace is genuine. MAGIC MOZ (2) has been left with too much ground to bridge in both runs back but has been warming late. Will appreciate the rise in trip and strikes a thin contest. Bold showing anticipated. KEY COMPONENT (8) is yet to strike fresh but was a consistent mare last time in and has peaks that measure up. This is short of her best trip but is a good kick-off point for the prep. Not taking lightly. KACHINA GIRL (11) can be forgiven for a plain fifth at Tara, but her Nanango third two back reads better and she gets in with 54kg fourth-up.
